prior.evidence: Technical plan C now specifies a dedicated controller-owned Print/PDF snapshot built from the requested source revision, PDF projection, and document options, with appearance-independent styles. Printing requires matching render, diagrams/images, and font/image readiness; source/document/destination/options changes invalidate the snapshot before invocation. Failure offers retry that renders the current request. The ready value is explicitly a print snapshot rather than a downloadable PDF, and native print requires an explicit user action with external completion unknown. The Behavior section adds delayed compilation/font/asset tests, edit/document-switch coverage, current-revision/PDF-projection checks, at-most-one invocation per gesture, and failure/retry validation. These decisions satisfy the original current-source print and truthful retry/outcome obligations.
